maria.docs: Heads-up: PR #1243 updates SDK snippets for streaming+pagination in Python/TS/Go. Need review on backcompat and small link fixes in docs. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1243
kevin.sdk: On it — quick skim. Are we changing the paginated iterator API?
maria.docs: No API change, just examples using async iterators and the new retry helpers. We added a tiny helper 'retry_with_backoff' in examples.
ashok: Can you paste the Py snippet? Faster to eyeball.
maria.docs: Here's the Python example I added:
```python
async def list_messages(client):
    async for page in client.paginate('/messages', params={'limit': 50}):
        for msg in page.items:
            print(msg.text)

# streaming example
async for chunk in client.stream('/generate', model='xlarge'):
    print(chunk.delta)

# helper
async def retry_with_backoff(fn, tries=3):
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            return await fn()
        except Exception:
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (2 ** i))
    raise
```
kevin.sdk: Looks good. For TS we should show `for await (const chunk of stream)` and include AbortController for cancellation/backpressure.
jamie: Also add a short migration note for users on SDK v0.x: replace `stream_iter` -> `stream` and link to migration guide. The old link was 404.
maria.docs: Added the migration blurb and fixed the migration URL to https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/sdk-v1
docs-bot: Deploy preview built: https://deploy.preview/docs/changes/1243 — link check: passed ✅
kevin.sdk: One more nit: Go snippet should show context cancellation + using github.com/cenkalti/backoff for retries. Small code tweak suggested.
maria.docs: Pushed a patch with the Go change and a tiny wording tweak in the pagination example. PTAL.
ashok: LGTM. Minor nit: add :thumbsup: reaction.
maria.docs: :shipit: I'll merge after CI green. Thanks all!
